legend: Mixed ductal adenocarcinoma-neuroendocrine carcinoma (large cell type), adenocarcinoma with ductal differentiation and sheets of neuroendocrine carcinoma composed of cells containing abundant cytoplasm and vesicular nuclei are seen. There is frequent mitoses and presence of tumor necrosis.

diagnosis: Mixed neuroendocrine-non-neuroendocrine neoplasm (MiNEN) of the pancreas head (tumor size: 3 cm) composed of two morphologically recognizable components of ductal adenocarcinoma G3
legend: The synaptophysin expression is intense and diffuse but limited to the PanNET component; note the central portion of the lesion where the two components are intimately intermingled (see also the H&E WSI).
source: Alessandro Vanoli (WSI sent by Guido Rindi)

diagnosis: Mixed neuroendocrine-non-neuroendocrine neoplasm (MiNEN) of the pancreas head (tumor size: 3 cm) composed of two morphologically distinguished components of ductal adenocarcinoma G3 – about 70% of the lesion - and NET G3 (Ki67, MIB-1, 30%, hot spot area; mitotic index of 11/2 mm2) – about 30% of the lesion
legend: Note the central part of the lesion where the two components are intimately intermingled (see also the synaptophysin WSI).
source: Alessandro Vanoli (WSI sent by Guido Rindi)

legend: The ductal component (left) is intimately admixed with the neuroendocrine component (right).

The acinar and neuroendocrine components are distinguishable histologically. The peripheral region adjacent to the fibrous pseudocapsule is composed of a band of neuroendocrine cells, whereas the central portion is acinar.
